title: Nannan in Danger
summary: The Jiang family orders an all-out search for the Ruthless lineage. Ye Fan meets up with Hei Huang, Pang Bo and the bandit brothers, and tells them that Hua Yunfei's parting words and the soul clones' aura point to the Yaoguang Holy Son as the masked Heaven-Painting Staff attacker at Yaochi. Hei Huang explains the Ruthless Emperor's rise through the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Art. When they visit Nannan, they find her memory wiped and her gone; the woman who promised to look after her has tracked her to a Yin-Yang Sect branch, where child prodigies are being force-fed drugs and Nannan is judged worthless and nearly killed. The woman kills five guards while Nannan counts to five. A Dragon Transformation level 4 Yin-Yang elder then confronts Ye Fan; Pang Bo joins in with the Demon Emperor's Nine Slashes, and Ye Fan beats the elder with the Battle Holy Technique. All the children are freed.
